_comment: Producer keys allowed to submit graph deltas. Copy to
trusted_delta_producers.json and edit — the real file is gitignored.
A missing or malformed file trusts NOBODY, which means every remote
delta submission is refused. That is the intended failure direction.
Generate a keypair with:  qlang graph keygen --out ~/.qlang/worker.key
It prints the public half in exactly the shape below.
Timestamps are unix seconds and are judged against the RECEIVER's clock,
never the delta's own emitted_at — otherwise a submitter could backdate
Rotation:  give the new key its own key_id, and set accept_until on the
old one so in-flight work keeps landing during the switchover.
Revocation: set revoked_at. It overrides accept_until immediately — a
leaked key must stop working the moment you know, not when the window ends.

worker-3.comment: replace with the public_key_hex that keygen printed
